scientific.integrity: The claim is derived from the exact branch-averaged second-moment recursion of the original pre-step-refresh Loopless SVRG update. The characteristic cubic is tested with the complete real Jury criterion, and all nonbinding Jury inequalities are proved positive on the proposed region.
limitations: The result is for two scalar components with uniform sampling and refresh probability one half.
It concerns mean-square stability rather than pathwise monotonicity.
Higher-dimensional noncommuting Hessians, arbitrary refresh probability, minibatches, proximal terms, and post-step snapshot variants are not covered.
A residual originality risk remains for equivalent calculations under stochastic-approximation or switched-system terminology.

title: Sharp mean-square stability frontier for two-client Loopless SVRG
